# DTT Ireland
> Independent Android study app for the Irish driving theory test, with Car and Motorcycle study paths.

DTT Ireland supports English, Irish, Polish, Portuguese, Ukrainian, Arabic, Urdu, Romanian and Simplified Chinese. Motorcycle practice and Simplified Chinese are available in the latest Android release. The app is free to download; Pro Car, Pro Motorcycle and Pro Both are available in the app. Consult the purchase screen for current prices and included features. Existing Car access does not automatically include Motorcycle.

DTT Ireland is not affiliated with the RSA, NDLS or Prometric. It does not book official tests or replace IBT. App study languages are not a statement of which languages are offered at an official test. Official services linked in the guides are authoritative for requirements and bookings.

- [Languages](https://dttireland.com/languages.html): nine supported study languages.

- [FAQ](https://dttireland.com/faq.html): common product questions.
- [About](https://dttireland.com/about.html): publisher information and contact.

- [Chinese study guide](https://dttireland.com/blog/irish-theory-test-chinese-study-guide.html): bilingual study advice and official language-support distinction.
- [November 2026 permit changes](https://dttireland.com/blog/learner-permit-renewal-rules-november-2026.html): dated guidance with official sources.

This optional text index summarises public pages; it is not an alternative to them. For changing requirements, follow the official source links and review dates on the relevant guide.
